en: Colorized historic street scene showing a wide cobblestone street lined with two- and three‑story buildings with red tiled roofs. Numerous pedestrians in late 19th–early 20th century clothing, including soldiers, women in long dresses and hats, children, and a dog, stand and walk along the street. Shopfronts with German signage are visible on the right. The caption at the top reads "Theresienstadt. Prager‑Gasse." indicating the view of Prager Gasse in Theresienstadt.
